doc: A Mars-like body (radius 3389.5 km, g 3.721, H 11.1 km, 1.026 d): hadley 42.08, scale 1.018 (g H / (Omega a): the lower g and larger H nearly cancel at a spin close to that of Earth). 181 float64 latitudes -90..90 every degree. Float64 closed form (gaussians, a smoothstep, a scale): rtol 1e-9. Arguments: lat (input, rad), hadley_deg and body (params). Measured: one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 1.9e-14 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is about 3e4x that spread.
